series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)

pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0291: The young herdsman came back with warm light-brown hair and a soft, almost feminine face, breaking the single most load-bearing trait in the episode — the Valyrian silver-gold/blond lock — and drifting toward the actress-likeness failure seen in Batches 026 and 027. Must be rerendered with explicitly cool platinum silver-white hair, a harder angular male jawline and the face never square to camera.
pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0300: The elder is back in an ankle-length flared coat with the hood UP and a pale fur mantle, which is the exact Batch 029 failure recurring: the silhouette reads as a figure in a long modern coat rather than a 48-year-old flocksman in a knee-length felted cloak. Must be rerendered with a hoodless head, a knee-length cloak stopping above the boot tops, matte ash-white hair visible from behind, and a broad male shoulder line.

visual_qc_note: Eight of ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 13OX8F00yUGUB4cXK7WndAHVN4gcBy0Tv and each Drive MD5 matches its local file. IMG0300 was reframed from a 1376x744 image area to full-bleed 1376x768 to strip 12 px letterbox bars before review. Two frames are held for rerender for the reasons in pending_reasons. Director's boundaries held across all ten: no cave interior, cavern mouth, tunnel or vent interior is shown; no sheep is taken on camera; no bones, blood or struggle appear before IMG0299's ambiguous skull; and no dragon or dragon-sign appears anywhere.
